summary: Iteration 18 - Email & Notifications System. All 16 backend tests PASSED, all frontend UI elements verified. Fixed PUT /notifications/settings endpoint which was missing Body(...) annotation.

features_tested: GET /api/notifications/events returns 10 notification events with id, label, description, category
GET /api/notifications/settings returns settings with enabled, recipient_roles, etc
PUT /api/notifications/settings saves notification settings correctly (FIXED - added Body annotation)
GET /api/notifications/recipients returns staff members with id, full_name, email, role
POST /api/notifications/test sends test email (domain error on free tier is expected)
GET /api/notifications/broadcast-history returns history of sent broadcasts
Frontend: Email & Notifications tab visible in Data Management
Frontend: Notification Rules subtab shows events grouped by category (Marketing, Finance, Operations)
Frontend: Each event has toggle ON/OFF, role badges, specific staff badges, custom email input
Frontend: Broadcast tab has recipient dropdown, subject, message, attachment upload, send button
Frontend: History tab shows broadcast history entries with status and error messages

TestNotificationEvents.test_events_have_required_fields: PASSED - All events have id, label, description, category

TestNotificationSettings.test_settings_have_required_fields: PASSED - All settings have event_id, enabled, recipient_roles

TestNotificationRecipients.test_recipients_have_required_fields: PASSED - All have id, full_name, email, role

TestBroadcast.test_send_broadcast_with_custom_emails: PASSED - Broadcast sent to verified email

TestBroadcastHistory.test_history_entries_have_expected_field: PASSED - Entries have subject, recipient_count, sent_at

results.login_and_navigation: PASSED - Admin login and navigation to Data Management works
results.subtabs: PASSED - Notification Rules, Broadcast / Greetings, History all present
results.notification_rules_ui: PASSED - Categories (MARKETING, FINANCE, OPERATIONS), 10 toggle switches, role badges, staff badges, custom email input visible
results.broadcast_form: PASSED - Recipients dropdown, Subject, Message, Attachment upload, Send button all present
results.history_display: PASSED - Broadcast history shows sent broadcasts with status, timestamps, sender name

bug_fixed.root_cause: FastAPI expected settings:list parameter to be wrapped in {"settings": [...]} but frontend sends plain list
bug_fixed.fix: Added Body(...) annotation to accept raw list as request body

minor.issue: After any setting is saved, only saved settings are returned (not merged with defaults). This means initially all 10 events show settings, but after modifying one, only that one is returned.
minor.suggestion: Consider merging saved settings with defaults for all events not yet saved
